body:
Session 2026-08-29: metanarrative model realignment, plus the vuoro-evidence recovery.

## What is done and verified

1. vuoro-evidence recovered from bytecode. All nine library modules byte-exact
   (recompiled output matches the surviving .pyc, line and column table
   included). test_boundary and test_generic_paths rewritten in full;
   test_ingress covers the HostProto lane. 16 tests pass. vuoro main.
2. outctl retired: command_capture decoder and its two tests removed, git
   history retains them. registered_profiles() is now ("hostproto",).
3. SubagentStop hook registered. Emits dispatch.exit with auditctl's existing
   terminal_reason vocabulary, which had no producer since actionq-daemon was
   retired 2026-08-22. Verified writing real events. Includes cascade harvest
   (sibling transcript paths), because a dying parent orphans finished children.
4. capability-receipt v2: draft -> current -> superseded; ratification replaced
   by established_by + authority_basis + validity; basis_for added. v1 files
   still validate by in-memory migration.
5. The metanarrative model: claim / observation / commitment /
   realignment-session schemas, a normative validator with current_claims() and
   observational_status() projections, and metanarrative.py as the one CLI.
   status wired into the SessionStart hook. agentops main, 1439 tests pass.
6. owner-reserved removed from both vocabularies. Human judgment is
   perpendicular: meta-sessions outside the workstream, never a stage in it.
7. kctl categories admit tenet and direction. PR #8, not merged.

## Where to start

The plan is docs/plans/agentops/meta-narrative-plan-2026-08-29.md (rev. 2).
Its section 10 first moves, in order:

1. DONE - make dispatched death observable (item 3 above).
2. Fix telemetry capture, then recompute rather than convert. Capture is worse
   than reported: 12 sessions in the 08-2x shards against 61 in the cost log.
   The artifacts-root default exists, so that is NOT the cause; the likely cause
   is `command -v auditctl` failing in a non-login hook shell (auditctl lives in
   ~/.local/bin). subagent-exit.sh already has the fallback; log-session-cost.sh
   does not. That is the next concrete fix.
3. Prove recovery as an outcome: a failing black-box resume scenario, then
   implement until it passes.
4. Pin scorer revisions in acceptance-lab. Verified present defect:
   EvaluationResult pins scenario_version, SCORERS is an unversioned dict of 13
   callables. Until fixed, no evaluation is comparable across time.
5. Extract the bindery-core accept/reject/merge cycle as a reusable scenario.
6. Then run the loop once, manually.

## Do not re-derive these

- session resume is a convenience aggregate over three served surfaces, all
  served today. Its absence costs six commands, not a capability.
- All seven hostproto repos and browser-workbench have reachable remotes and
  zero unpushed commits. The "no git remote" claim was false.
- The cost over-count is a consumer-side summing bug and is recomputable;
  metadata.session survives. Do not publish a conversion factor.
- Half the orchestration loop is already built in
  templates/dispatch/session-mechanization/ with 24 passing tests.
- Reservations are detectors, not leases. Duplicate-execution safety rests on
  dedup_key, CAS on item status, and exact-revision receipts.

## Open judgement, not blocked work

- practice publishes to kctl as decision rather than a first-class category.
- Which changes, if any, warrant standing-policy rather than delegated
  authority basis is unexercised: every record written so far is delegated.
